marta (docs): quick sync  PR 4132 introduces the new model-card yaml keys (supported_variants -> variants) + a new 'recommended_profile' field. Need: short compatibility blurb, updated limits matrix (per plan), a tiny JS fetch snippet for the migration, and a short bench note for q4h vs fp16. link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4132
ryan (eng-ml): I'll drop the bench numbers here. Test rig: a100x2, mixed batch sizes, q4h vs fp16. Median tokens/ms: q4h 0.022 (45ms/token at typical), fp16 0.018. 32k context runs ~2.6x slower than 8k in our runs. I'll attach CSV to the PR.
kai (devex): JS fetch snippet (tiny):
```js
fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${REDWOOD_KEY}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'zephyr-aurora-q4h', input: 'Summarize long doc', max_tokens: 512 })
}).then(r => r.json()).then(console.log)
```
marta (docs): good. Can you add a one-liner about kv-cache compatibility for q4h? Also we need a tiny YAML snippet showing the new 'variants' format for model-cards. Keep it minimal.
ryan (eng-ml): kv-cache note: "KV cache preserved for q4h autoregressive flows; some attention kernels fall back to fp16 for long context which may slightly change perf and determinism." Happy to shorten.
nathan (product): Add a short cross-ref sentence in Dedicated docs: "Dedicated pools may default to different quantization profiles; check pool configuration." Keep it as a single-line callout.
kai (devex): Minimal model-card yaml example for migration (one-liner values):
```yaml
model: zephyr-aurora
variants:
  - name: zephyr-aurora
    recommended_profile: fp16
  - name: zephyr-aurora-q4h
    recommended_profile: q4h
limits:
  max_input_tokens: 32768
  recommended_batch_size: 8
```
marta (docs): thanks  I'll include that under the migration section and add a table column 'recommended_profile'. Can folks sanity-check the limits? I tentatively set 32k for the public API and 'recommended_batch_size' conservative values per model.
ryan (eng-ml): Sanity check: 32k is ok for zephyr variants on large GPU configs; recommend caveat: "effective max may vary by deployment and quant profile". For public API put a footnote that Dedicated/private defaults can be higher.
kai (devex): small curl example for the quickstart migration note: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"zephyr-aurora-q4h","input":"Summarize this long file...","max_tokens":512}'
```
marta (docs): also please include a short 'how to test' suggestion for users: run a 1k token summary and diff outputs between q4h and fp16, and link to the eval harness in the repo. I'll add that link.
ryan (eng-ml): added quick perf footnote in the PR comment: "q4h memory footprint ~40% less than fp16 on our decode runs; quality delta small on newswire but noticeable on adversarial long summaries."
docs-bot: PR 4132 updated by @marta  reviewers requested: @ryan, @kai
marta (docs): Plan: I'll push the updated docs + snippets to the PR this afternoon. Ping me for final review and I'll merge after approvals. Thanks all!
kai (devex): will run snippets on staging and report back if anything breaks. :thumbsup:
